Add your own tests: copy an entry, give it a unique id. {COMPETITOR} is replaced with the competitor name chosen in setup. All keys and numbers here are randomly generated and invalid. '{_}' is removed at run time; it only stops secret scanners from flagging this file.

steps.title: Everyday work flows through
steps.talk: Most prompts are ordinary work. AI Guard lets them through with no friction, but it still classifies the topic, so you can see what your people use AI for.

steps.title: Sensitive data leaving the company
steps.talk: An employee pastes a patient record into a chatbot. AI Guard finds the SSN and date of birth before the prompt reaches the model. We're in monitor mode, so it's logged, not stopped.

steps.title: Secrets in a prompt
steps.talk: Developers paste tokens when they debug. AI Guard recognizes credential formats, so a leaked key becomes an alert instead of an incident.

steps.title: Prompt injection
steps.talk: This is the attack on the AI itself: telling the model to ignore its instructions. It's detected and recorded. Now let's enforce.

steps.title: Turn on enforcement, same prompt
steps.talk: Same prompt, one policy change. AI Guard now blocks it before it reaches the model. Customers usually start in monitor mode, learn their baseline, then enforce the high-risk detectors.

steps.title: Hidden instructions
steps.talk: Attackers hide instructions in invisible Unicode characters, in documents and web pages the AI reads. People can't see them. AI Guard can, and it blocks them.

steps.title: Risky model output
steps.talk: AI Guard inspects the response too. If a model or an agent returns personal data, it's caught on the way back.

steps.title: Brand and competitive risk
steps.talk: Beyond security: responsible-AI detectors flag competitor talk, brand risk and regulated advice. We're back in monitor mode now, and everything we just did is on the dashboard.

steps.title: Card number
steps.talk: Payment data in a prompt is detected before it leaves.

steps.title: Source code with a key
steps.talk: Private keys and tokens in code are recognized by format.

steps.title: The model leaks it back
steps.talk: Responses are checked as well, so a model can't hand secrets back out.
